name: Manifold Companion
description: Thin gateway harness for the manifold sidecar (own process, package-owned store at ~/.manifold). Proxies /manifold/* to the sidecar, runs agent dispatches on its behalf, relays canonical events to gateway broadcast. Opens no database. Requires a running sidecar (bin/manifold-sidecar.js, launchd ai.manifold.sidecar).

sidecarToken.description: Sidecar service token. Default: read from the sidecar's own token file (~/.manifold/.api-token).
